name: OmaRouting
author: makeitcount.tech
description: OmaRouting: per-app and default routing over VPN (WireGuard, Headscale/Tailscale, proxies) for Omarchy, built on sing-box. Omarchy bar VPN controls: authenticated application/default routing policy, separate managed browser profiles, Country → City → Server selection, and Settings connection imports. Host capture remains safety-gated; configured policy is not proof of active traffic.

barWidget.description: Configure observed application and default routes through the local runtime broker, manage separate browser profiles, and inspect explicit runtime status. Host capture requires its independent safety gate.

schema.label: sing-box config
schema.description: Read-only legacy display configuration. Application and managed-profile control uses the authenticated local runtime broker, never a caller-supplied Clash endpoint or bearer secret.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll the engine state and traffic totals. Live speed streams every second while the panel is open, independently of this.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What to show next to the icon while the tunnel is up.

schema.label: Hide when the tunnel is off
schema.description: Remove the widget from the bar entirely while disconnected. Leave off to keep a dimmed icon you can click to connect.

schema.label: Exit address lookup
schema.description: Which service is asked, through the tunnel and over HTTPS only, where traffic exits. Fixed choices rather than a URL, so the plugin can only ever talk to these. Off disables the lookup entirely.
